newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish thread producer Ceytas to float shares.
newsitem.headline: Turkish thread producer Ceytas to float shares.

text.p: Part of the capital of Turkish thread producer Ceytas Ceyhan Tekstil Sanayii A.S. will be offered to the public at a two-day offer from Thursday, offer manager Global securities said.
The sale price will be 3,300 lira per 1,000 lira nominal-valued share.
Ceytas plans to float 168 billion lira of new shares, waiving the preemptive rights, in a move which will raise its capital to 600 billion lira from 432 billion lira.
The company plans to increase its annual output capacity to 10,940 tonnes this year by continuing machinery modernisation investments, after a 23 percent rise in 1996 to 8,626 tonnes.
Ceytas posted 180.6 billion lira of net profits in the first nine months of 1996 and 138 billion lira in the whole of 1995.
Sales mounted to 1.4 trillion lira in the first nine months of 1996, up 152 percent from the same 1995 period.
The main shareholders of Ceytas are Turgay Ciner with 54.4 percent stake and textile company Cinteks of Park Holding with 29.7 percent.
Ceytas is the first company to go public out of 11 subsidiaries of Park Holding which is active in textile, energy, mining and airport ground services.
